_comment: M-sized task with one unknown (where the login handler and its tests live) and one risky step (the change sits on the auth surface). Proves the lane contract from the transcript's top-level tool calls: a scout before the first worker, workers on Sonnet, the risky step's worker on Opus, no planner/Fable on an M task, the leaf boundary in every spawn prompt, the coordinator editing nothing but .maximum-effort/, a plan with a check per step and every box ticked, a receipt line — and the limit actually enforced at runtime. Role agents are read from ~/.claude/agents (headless loads them); the checks accept the `model:` fallback too, so the case also passes on a machine without them installed. That machine state is outside the fingerprint — pass --no-cache after changing the agent files.
